summary: Frontend-only UI verification for Pulse Fitness MOD Operations polish: footer pinning, Synced pill removal for staff, staff dashboard restyle, launcher horizontal layout, AreaSwitcher rename, and engineer regression. All six checks PASS. The reported 'footer halfway up screen / large black empty area' bug is fixed — footer sits flush at bottom (viewport-pinned) on both content-heavy Dashboard and shorter Visiting Access. Any residual ~168px gap below the <footer> in scrollHeight is caused by the site-wide cookie consent banner (body class 'has-bottom-banner' reserves space for the fixed cookie banner) and is background-colored (light, matches page bg) — NOT a black empty region. No console errors, no horizontal overflow at 390px.
